mapper.sql: f.id, f.slot_version_id, f.asset_kind, f.logical_key, f.position, f.original_name, f.description, f.content_type, f.size_bytes, f.storage_key, f.external_url, f.uploaded_by, f.uploaded_at, a.name AS uploaded_by_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM file_asset f JOIN account a ON a.id = f.uploaded_by WHERE f.slot_version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY f.position, f.id
SELECT FROM file_asset f JOIN account a ON a.id = f.uploaded_by WHERE f.id = #{id}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(position), -1) FROM file_asset WHERE slot_version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_asset (slot_version_id, asset_kind, logical_key, position, original_name, description, content_type, size_bytes, storage_key, external_url, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{slotVersionId}, #{assetKind}, #{logicalKey}, #{position}, #{originalName}, #{description}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{storageKey}, #{externalUrl}, #{uploadedBy})
